# AutoReel

> AutoReel is a local-first Windows and macOS application for Vietnamese creators and affiliates. It creates videos in bulk from products, existing footage or an idea, adds Vietnamese voice-over, subtitles and branding, and publishes to Shopee Video and Facebook/Reels. The public site also has a free video downloader for TikTok, Douyin, YouTube, Bilibili, Hongguoduanju and iQiyi.

This file is an agent-readiness index, not a Google ranking file. Google Search ignores llms.txt (stated in its May 2026 AI optimisation guide); the pages below are the ones worth reading, and the sitemap is the complete list.

## Product

- [AutoReel home](https://autoreelvn.com/): what the app does, the three workflows, and the pricing table.
- [Pricing](https://autoreelvn.com/bang-gia-phan-mem-tao-video/): rent from 99,000₫/month or buy outright for 1,490,000₫. No per-video charge.
- [All features](https://autoreelvn.com/tat-ca-tinh-nang/): the complete list of the three flows and twelve single-job screens.
- [Video demo](https://autoreelvn.com/video-demo-thuc-te/): 1m34s recording from the running app.
- [Reference pacing](https://autoreelvn.com/lam-theo-mau/): build a new video with the same pacing and structure as a reference, without reusing its footage.

## Free tools

- [Video downloader](https://autoreelvn.com/downloads/): public videos and platform subtitles, no login.
